explication: Eclipse Zenoh is a distributed data platform combining pub/sub, queries, storage, and computation. An application opens a Session, publishes or subscribes to keyed data, or builds a query; the routing layer dispatches it across protocol and transport layers to local or remote resources, then delivers samples or replies back through API handlers. The router daemon adds plugin-hosted services such as storage. This map emphasizes documented capabilities and sampled control points; several internal routing calls are inferred only at subsystem boundaries.
